active_dr.nominal_fraction_target: inherited gain mixture only; independent mass and selected startup materials have no nominal mixture
active_dr.stage: repaired Step7 plus startup body mass and explicit motor output scale

delay.sampling: independent group lag at env reset; fixed within episode
delay.previous_action: last raw clamped policy output; execution delay does not overwrite it

body_mass_randomization.sampling: independent per environment and selected rigid body at startup; fixed across resets
body_mass_randomization.inertia: nominal inertia tensor scaled by that body's mass ratio
body_mass_randomization.critic_mass_slot: actual total robot mass divided by nominal total mass; existing 78D layout

effort_output_scale.sampling: independent per env/active motor, first reset and eligible reset after 720 global policy steps
effort_output_scale.application: full raw PD torque multiplied before original DC envelope; inherited additive noise then final envelope
effort_output_scale.critic: existing stiffness/damping slots report effective PD gains; actual applied torque slot retained; 78D unchanged

contact_material.sampling: startup; independent per-env/per-shape bucket selection; selected properties fixed across resets
contact_material.critic: existing six slots: actual left/right wheel material triple; shape mean if multi-shape; no base/guide encoding; 78D retained

velocity_push.sampling: native EventManager interval; timer resampled on reset
velocity_push.semantics: add delta to world XY velocity; z and angular unchanged
